+# Taskboard CLI
+
+Dependency-free task manager for Bun. Each command prints exactly one JSON value to standard output.
+
+Run commands with `bun run src/cli.ts`. Data is stored in `.taskboard.json` in the current directory, or at the path set by `TASKBOARD_FILE`.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Ship release" --tags work,urgent --due 2026-10-01
+bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag urgent
+bun run src/cli.ts list --overdue 2026-10-01
+bun run src/cli.ts done 1
+bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
+bun run src/cli.ts stats
+```
+
+Tags are trimmed, lowercased, and deduplicated. Dates must be real calendar dates in `YYYY-MM-DD` form. Writes use a temporary sibling file followed by a rename, so malformed input or failed commands never replace the existing database.

Implemented Taskboard CLI in `src/cli.ts` and added `README.md`.

- Add, list/filter, done idempotency, delete, stats

- Malformed databases fail without replacement
- Atomic sibling temp-file writes via synchronous write and rename
